single.sql:
SELECT memory, distance, cycles_per_atomic
FROM atomic
WHERE mode = 'latency'
single.transformScript:
# One value per job (memory, and dsmem target rank): the median over
# the repetitions.
df = df.groupby(['memory', 'distance'], as_index=False)['cycles_per_atomic'].median()
single.layoutScript:
# a2av.cu figure, in the house style of dgx-spark/latency/plot/plotstyle.py.
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13,
    "legend.title_fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3, "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 6,
}
# DSMEM methods in blues/purple, global-memory methods in oranges/red.
METHODS = {
    "dsmem-push": ("#1f77b4", "o"), "dsmem-pull": ("#17becf", "o"), "dsmem-bulk": ("#9467bd", "o"),
    "gmem-ldst": ("#ff7f0e", "s"), "gmem-tma": ("#d62728", "s"),
}
DISTRIBUTIONS = ["UNIMODALFLAT", "UNIMODALPEAK", "MONOTONEDECAY", "HEAVYTAIL"]


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)


def message_size_axis(ax, sizes):
    """log2 x axis labelled with the message sizes that were run."""
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}" if s < 1024 else f"{s // 1024} Ki" for s in sizes])


def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""
    axes = fig.subplots(rows, cols, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False).ravel()
    for ax in axes[len(distributions):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))


def one_legend(fig, axes):
    """A single legend above the panels instead of one per panel."""
    handles, labels = {}, {}
    for ax in axes:
        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
            handles.setdefault(l, h)
    fig.legend(handles.values(), handles.keys(), loc="outside upper center",
               ncol=len(handles), frameon=False)

COLORS = {"smem": "#2ca02c", "dsmem": "#1f77b4", "global": "#d62728"}


def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (15, 5.4))
    left, right = fig.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True, gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1, 2.6]})

    # Left: one bar per memory (dsmem: the median over the target ranks).
    names, values = [], []
    for memory in ("smem", "dsmem", "global"):
        part = df[df["memory"] == memory]
        if len(part):
            names.append(memory)
            values.append(part["cycles_per_atomic"].median())
    bars = left.bar(names, values, color=[COLORS[n] for n in names], width=0.6)
    for b, v in zip(bars, values):
        left.text(b.get_x() + b.get_width() / 2, v, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
                  fontsize=14)
    left.set_ylabel("cycles per atomic (dependent chain)")
    left.set_title("by memory")

    # Right: dsmem, rank 0 to every other rank of a 12-block cluster.
    d = df[df["memory"] == "dsmem"].sort_values("distance")
    bars = right.bar(d["distance"], d["cycles_per_atomic"], color=COLORS["dsmem"], width=0.7)
    for b, v in zip(bars, d["cycles_per_atomic"]):
        right.text(b.get_x() + b.get_width() / 2, v, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
                   fontsize=12)
    right.set_xticks(d["distance"].tolist())
    right.set_xlabel("target rank (rank 0 does the atomics)")
    right.set_title("dsmem, by target")
    for axis in (left, right):
        axis.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)
        axis.grid(False, axis="x")
        axis.set_axisbelow(True)

single.sql:
SELECT memory, op, pattern, counters, clusters, gatomics_per_s
FROM atomic
WHERE mode = 'throughput'
single.transformScript:
# One point per job: the median over the repetitions. `clusters` is how
# many ran at once: 1, or as many as fit (the whole chip).
df = df.groupby(['memory', 'op', 'pattern', 'counters', 'clusters'], as_index=False)['gatomics_per_s'].median()
single.layoutScript:
# a2av.cu figure, in the house style of dgx-spark/latency/plot/plotstyle.py.
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13,
    "legend.title_fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3, "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 6,
}
# DSMEM methods in blues/purple, global-memory methods in oranges/red.
METHODS = {
    "dsmem-push": ("#1f77b4", "o"), "dsmem-pull": ("#17becf", "o"), "dsmem-bulk": ("#9467bd", "o"),
    "gmem-ldst": ("#ff7f0e", "s"), "gmem-tma": ("#d62728", "s"),
}
DISTRIBUTIONS = ["UNIMODALFLAT", "UNIMODALPEAK", "MONOTONEDECAY", "HEAVYTAIL"]


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)


def message_size_axis(ax, sizes):
    """log2 x axis labelled with the message sizes that were run."""
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}" if s < 1024 else f"{s // 1024} Ki" for s in sizes])


def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""
    axes = fig.subplots(rows, cols, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False).ravel()
    for ax in axes[len(distributions):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))


def one_legend(fig, axes):
    """A single legend above the panels instead of one per panel."""
    handles, labels = {}, {}
    for ax in axes:
        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
            handles.setdefault(l, h)
    fig.legend(handles.values(), handles.keys(), loc="outside upper center",
               ncol=len(handles), frameon=False)

# (memory, op, pattern) -> label, colour, line style. dsmem compiles to the
# same instruction for add and fetch-add (see atomic.cu): only fetch-add shown.
LINES = [
    ("smem", "add", None, "smem, add", "#2ca02c", "-"),
    ("smem", "fetch-add", None, "smem, fetch-add", "#2ca02c", "--"),
    ("global", "add", None, "global, add", "#d62728", "-"),
    ("global", "fetch-add", None, "global, fetch-add", "#d62728", "--"),
    ("dsmem", "fetch-add", "ring", "dsmem, ring (one owner each)", "#1f77b4", "-"),
    ("dsmem", "fetch-add", "broadcast", "dsmem, broadcast (one owner)", "#17becf", "--"),
]


def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (15, 6.2))
    alone, full = fig.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True)
    counters = sorted(df["counters"].unique())
    for axis, chip_full in ((alone, False), (full, True)):
        part = df[(df["clusters"] > 1) == chip_full]
        for memory, op, pattern, label, color, style in LINES:
            line = part[(part["memory"] == memory) & (part["op"] == op)]
            if pattern:
                line = line[line["pattern"] == pattern]
            line = line.sort_values("counters")
            axis.plot(line["counters"], line["gatomics_per_s"], color=color, linestyle=style,
                      marker="o", label=label)
        n = int(part["clusters"].max()) if len(part) else 0
        axis.set_title("whole chip (%d clusters of 12)" % n if chip_full else "one cluster of 12 blocks")
        axis.set_xscale("log", base=2)
        axis.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(counters))
        axis.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
        axis.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%d"))
        axis.set_yscale("log")
        axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%g"))
        axis.set_xlabel("distinct counters (1 = everybody on one address)")
    alone.set_ylabel("G atomics / s")
    one_legend(fig, [alone, full])
